member_definition.scope: Detailing generally follows normal RC structures except reinforcement provision/spacing, cover, and durability requirements are more onerous. Governed by BS EN 1992-3 (EC2 Part 3).
member_definition.key_difference_from_normal_structures: Serviceability (crack width) often controls design/reinforcement quantity, not just ultimate strength. Construction and movement joints MUST be shown on drawings (not just specification) because reinforcement for thermal/shrinkage restraint depends on joint frequency/spacing — Designer's responsibility to position all joints.

table_9_1.requirement: Some leakage acceptable / leakage of liquids irrelevant.
Leakage limited to small amount; some surface staining/damp patches acceptable.
Leakage minimal; appearance not impaired by staining.

tightness_classes.class_0_detail: Same provisions as retaining walls apply. Minimum wall thickness 120mm.

class_1_detail.crack_width_formula: wk1: for hD/hw ≤ 5, wk1=0.2mm; for hD/hw ≥ 25, wk1=0.05mm; linear interpolation between.
class_1_detail.rationale: Limiting crack width to these values should allow effective self-healing within a relatively short time.

class_2_detail.note: Cracks passing through full section thickness should generally be avoided unless liners/water bars incorporated.

tightness_classes.class_3_detail: Special measures (liners or prestress) generally required.
tightness_classes.aesthetic_case: Where aesthetic appearance critical, crack width limited to 0.1mm.

cover.note: Greater cover may be needed at faces in contact with aggressive soils, or subject to erosion/abrasion.

spacing.rule: Pitch reduces rapidly — see EC2 Part 3 Cl.7.3.3 (dependency, not fully restated here)

prestressed_walls.min_passive_reinforcement: 300 mm²/m or 0.001·Ac, each direction, each face.

circular_tanks.tendon_centroid_rule: Should generally lie in outer third of wall thickness; may relax to outer half if cover otherwise impossible.

opening_corners.rule: Detailing must ensure diagonal tension faces adequately catered for; strut-and-tie system (EC2 Cl.5.6.4) is an appropriate design approach.

joint_types_shown.name: Construction joint (rebar continuous through joint, with hydrophilic strip)
components: crack inducer filled with sealing compound

joint_types_shown.name: Construction joint (rebar continuous, waterstop with crack inducer)
Movement joint (expansion type waterstop, rebar stopped at joint)

decision_rules.rule: IF designing reinforcement for a water-retaining member in a given direction THEN provide the LARGER of the reinforcement required for structural actions and the reinforcement required for restraint to thermal contraction/drying shrinkage.
Positions of ALL construction joints and movement joints MUST be shown on the detailed drawings (unlike normal structures where this may be left to specification).
The Designer is responsible for positioning all joints, because thermal/shrinkage reinforcement quantity depends on joint frequency/spacing.
IF Tightness Class 0 THEN treat as for retaining walls; minimum wall thickness 120mm.
IF Tightness Class 1 THEN limit full-depth cracks to wk1 (per hD/hw interpolation formula); minimum wall thickness 150mm.
IF Tightness Class 2 THEN full-depth cracks should generally be avoided UNLESS liners/water bars are incorporated; minimum wall thickness 150mm.
IF Tightness Class 3 THEN special measures (liners or prestress) are generally required.
IF aesthetic appearance is critical THEN crack width should be limited to 0.1mm.
Nominal cover for water-retaining structures should not be less than 40mm; greater cover needed at faces exposed to aggressive soils/erosion/abrasion.

IF tensile reinforcement bar stress ≤150 MPa THEN bar spacing ≤250mm; distribution bar spacing ≤150mm (preferably closer). IF bar stress is higher THEN pitch must reduce rapidly per EC2 Part 3 Cl.7.3.3.
IF a wall is prestressed THEN minimum passive reinforcement of 300mm²/m or 0.001·Ac is required in each direction and each face.

IF detailing a circular tank THEN the centroid of horizontal prestressing tendons should generally lie in the outer third of the wall, relaxable to the outer half if cover otherwise impossible; duct diameter must not exceed 20% of wall thickness.
decision_rules.type: recommendation with conditional relaxation + mandatory maximum

decision_rules.rule: IF detailing an opening corner THEN reinforcement must ensure diagonal tension faces are adequately catered for; a strut-and-tie approach (EC2 Cl.5.6.4) is appropriate.

derived_parameters.wk1_crack_width: interpolate(hD/hw): 0.2mm at ratio<=5, 0.05mm at ratio>=25, linear between

recovered_information_pass.W1_partial_joints_scope_limitation: Partial joints are NOT covered in EC2, Part 3 (§9.1, p.162).
recovered_information_pass.W3_diffusion_caveat: All concrete will permit the passage of small quantities of liquids and gases by diffusion, regardless of tightness class (p.162).
